summary: New tutorial 'Events, Regions, and Celestials' (id dynasty-deck, issue #1074): Unicorn Maidens (you) vs Mantis Manipulation, 22 steps. Dark Experiments (click a Mantis Province, Confirm), Natural Aviary, Ebisu's Honesty, buying Prosperous Village, then the Mantis turn (Shinden Shorai + Yoritomo's Guidance enter; Border Keep's first-turn refresh reveals Plains of Otosan Uchi, Suitengu's Blessing - which replaces Yoritomo's Guidance - and Boastful Proclamation; the Region does not attach, the Event does not resolve). Core adds tutorial-only Events-phase stops (MatchEngine.TutorialHoldReveal, before/after a province is revealed; the Celestial sweep honours it) and TutorialContext.HoldReveal/FoeBorderKeep; no rules change (ResolveRevealedCard is a pure extraction). Client: UI scripts for the new move steps, --tutorial-lesson=<id> in the lab, and the native UI check now plays this lesson too.
validation: check.sh --skip-client passed (7 new tutorial-dynasty tests: whole lesson, Province choice restrictions, per-province Events stops, Mantis turn, quoted numbers, step shape, Back at every step); tools/check-tutorial.sh passed natively (lesson 1 59 steps + this lesson 22 steps through the real table controls, incl. clicking a Province then Confirm choice and buying the Village); captured steps event/marker/one-celestial/boastful and inspected them. No full human playthrough.
remaining: Cosmetic: the card-details panel still shows the last inspected card (Prosperous Village) later in the lesson. The 'bullet point in the turn marker' glow is the existing whole-phase-bar glow, not a glow on only the current phase marker. Dark Experiments may not name the leftmost Mantis Province (a Region attaching there is destroyed and would break the Mantis turn). The user's script listed Suitengu's Blessing in step 13; Yoritomo's Guidance is the Celestial that enters first (step 15 discards it). Not a human acceptance.
